abstract: Two-mode (Quick Pass / Full Review) visual inspection skill. Renders PDFs and HTML at 300 DPI, produces action-first reports (HOLD/FIX IF TIME/NOTE), detects clipping, overlaps, font fallback, density imbalance, and brand drift. Includes 8 mandatory bottom-edge checks, Paged.js-specific structural patterns (orphan borders, footer collisions, flowing section overflow), form-aware checks, and type-specific checks for slides, books, and reports.
